summary: Full backend + frontend validation of iter-7 features: Routes master, Custom Fields, Item Import, Import Templates, Bulk WhatsApp, and Customer form with route/custom. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed (test_iter7_routes_customfields_items.py) — routes CRUD w/ admin RBAC + 409 duplicate + 5 seeded routes {North,South,East,West,Central}; custom-fields type/options validation (dropdown-without-options→400, invalid type→400), admin-only, list/create/delete OK, dropdown options are trimmed and empty entries dropped; customer create with 'route' + 'custom' dict persists and comes back via GET /customers/{id} and via list filters ?route=&customer_type=; item import CSV skip vs update flow produced 3-created/3-skipped/3-updated exactly, values persisted in /api/items; xlsx templates return 200 with the exact expected header rows; salesman blocked (403) from all admin write endpoints. Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin admin@fmcg.com): More tab shows all 5 new rows (menu-import-items, menu-bulk-whatsapp, menu-routes, menu-custom-fields, menu-import-customers); Routes screen creates 'TEST_UI_R7' and it appears in the list; Custom Fields screen creates text field 'TEST UI Shop Size' and dropdown 'TEST UI Grade [A,B,C]' — both listed with correct type badge; Add Customer form now renders 6 Route chips (route-<id>) AND both custom fields as chip-set (cf-test_ui_grade-A/B/C) + text input (cf-test_ui_shop_size); saving a customer with shop_name + mobile + North route + custom values persists — verified via backend GET returning route='North' and custom={test_ui_shop_size:'Large Shop', test_ui_grade:'B'}; Import Items: 'Download template' triggers a real browser download of 'item_import_template.xlsx'; CSV upload for 2 rows via expect_file_chooser returns Created=2/Updated=0/Skipped=0; 'View Items' navigates to /items and TEST UI Item A/B are visible; Import Customers screen has a working 'import-template' Pressable that downloads 'customer_import_template.xlsx'; Bulk WhatsApp: route/type/search filters all narrow the customer list correctly, Select all + individual selection both work (counter updates), Start Sending advances to sending phase: Sending 1/2 shows shop_name (Electronics Hub) with {shop_name} replaced in preview, Open WhatsApp button + 'Mark sent & Next' both present; Next advances to 2/2 (Fresh Foods Corner) and the 3rd tap lands on the 'All done!' screen with Finish button (bw-finish). Cleanup: deleted the test route, both custom fields, and the seeded test customer via API. No mocked APIs.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete uses React Native Alert.alert which on Expo Web does not render the destructive/Cancel buttons — tapping the trash icon shows no confirmation and the route is NOT deleted from the UI/DB. The delete flow only works on native. Recommend using a custom Modal/confirm on web, or Platform.select. On web the RN-web Alert polyfill only fires the first (default) button; wrapping onPress in Platform.OS==='web' ? window.confirm(...) : Alert.alert(...) fixes it.

The Modal + KeyboardAvoidingView slides up but Playwright reports type chips (cf-type-text/number/dropdown) as 'outside of viewport' on 390x844 — real mobile UX is fine, but on web the modal's transform-based slide-in animation can leave portions clipped in ScrollView. Recommend adding contentContainerStyle padding + ensuring modal max-height content is scrollable on short viewports. Workaround: dispatchEvent click via JS works.

Detail screen shows Contact + Business only; it does NOT display the selected Route or Custom Fields the user entered on the form. Persistence is fine (GET returns route+custom), but there is no read-only view of these values. Recommend adding a 'Route' row under Business and an 'Additional Details' section listing custom fields. Not blocking today's scope but requested via 'reopen the customer'.

issues: Long 'TEST UI Shop Size' custom field label wraps but Field component keeps label + input compact — OK. Chip row for dropdown wraps as expected.

react_native_issues.issue: Routes delete + Custom Fields delete both use Alert.alert(destructive) which does NOT render properly on React Native Web (Expo web preview). Reference: /app/frontend/app/routes.tsx:41 and /app/frontend/app/customer-fields.tsx:60.

action_items: Wrap the destructive Alert.alert in Routes and Custom Fields with Platform.OS==='web' ? window.confirm(msg) : Alert.alert(...) so delete works in the web preview too.
Consider displaying the customer's Route + Custom Fields on the Customer detail screen (read view) so admins can verify their entries without opening the Edit form.

OPTIONAL: Seed customers now have only 'area' set, not 'route' — dashboard/Bulk WhatsApp Central-route filter is empty until admins manually set routes. Not a bug, but consider mirroring area -> route on seed for demo.

backend/server.py:1490-1509 template endpoints correctly gated to admin (require_admin) and return xlsx MIME + Content-Disposition. openpyxl is available in requirements.
backend/server.py:619-641 customer list query correctly ANDs the ?route= and ?customer_type= filters into the mongo query — verified via 4 filter permutations.

frontend/src/screens/CustomerForm.tsx:184-197,226-255 conditionally renders Route chips (route-<id>) and Custom Fields block only when arrays are non-empty — clean fallback. setCustom writes into form.custom dict which POST /customers accepts as-is (backend CustomerIn.custom is Optional[dict]).

rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs. Two UX gaps on web only: (a) Alert.alert(destructive) on Routes/Custom Fields does not prompt on Expo Web — deleting from those screens silently no-ops on web (works fine on native). RCA: react-native-web Alert polyfill collapses to a single-button alert. Fix: gate on Platform.OS==='web' and use window.confirm, OR use a custom in-app confirm Modal. (b) Customer detail screen omits route/custom fields — purely a display gap, data is persisted correctly.
